items.subject: A futuristic single-seat anti-gravity racing quad-rotor drone craft: a low sleek twin-hull fuselage with a split forward air channel between two pointed prongs, a raised central cockpit pod with a dark tinted canopy, four short swept arms ending in four open circular rotor rings at the four corners, twin round ion thruster nozzles at the tail with cyan glowing cores, polished copper clearcoat body panels with brushed titanium and dark graphite composite parts, thin cyan accent light strips, panel lines and light wear

A hostile hovering interceptor sentry drone: a compact armoured swept-wing fuselage with two ducted rotors at the wingtips, a large round glowing red-orange sensor eye at the front centre like a bullseye, electric-cyan and hazard-crimson armour plates, gunmetal frame, small cannon barrels under the nose, panel lines and wear

A hostile heavy armoured hovering gunship drone: a bulky wide crimson-red armoured fuselage with wide forward-swept strike wings, two heavy rotor and weapon sponsons on the wing ends with twin cannon barrels, a big glowing amber reactor eye at the front, cyan trim lights, thick bolted armour plates, gunmetal steel, scratches and scorch marks

A tall slender futuristic race-track checkpoint pylon tower: a sculpted chamfered stone and metal anchor plinth at the bottom, rising into two tall razor-thin swept aerodynamic blade fins side by side with glowing cyan chevron light strips running up them, brushed titanium and dark anodised alloy, weathered by moon dust

A small stratified dark basalt rock mesa butte: layered horizontal rock terraces with eroded vertical cracks, a wide overhanging flat cap rock shelf on top, grey-black volcanic stone with pale dusty mineral bands, loose rubble at the base, like a lunar canyon rock formation

A cluster of glowing mineral chimney vents growing from a low layered basalt rock base: five crooked swept rock chimneys of different heights with frosted icy rims and faint glowing cyan crystals inside their mouths, dark volcanic rock with pale frost crust

A futuristic lunar-base cryo coolant tower: a curved hyperboloid hourglass tower shell of white-grey ceramic panels with an open top rim, a low faceted geodesic reactor dome attached at its base, pipes and access hatches, cyan glowing vents, panel seams and moon-dust weathering

A freestanding futuristic magnetic boost gate arch, front view: a tall pointed aerodynamic arch made of a sleek swept metal blade with segmented ribs, glowing cyan chevron lights along its inner edge, standing on two heavy dark basalt stone footings, brushed alloy and dark anodised metal

A volatile plasma containment drum: a heavy upright crimson-red armoured steel drum with three glowing neon amber and magenta containment rings around it, gold hazard chevron decals, armoured end caps, scratches and scorch marks
An upright ion-shield power-up capsule: a glowing faceted cyan crystal orb held between two brushed titanium end caps, wrapped by four twisted copper heat-pipe ribs, inside a clear glass sleeve

An upright repair power-up capsule: a glowing emerald-green energy cylinder held between two brushed titanium end caps, with three straight copper heat-pipe ribs around it, inside a clear glass sleeve
